The manager is instantly stunned, collapsing to the floor in shock. Trembling, he asks, "That's the CEO's VIP card! You are the CEO?！"

video:video.video:title: President's Sexy Wife
video:video.video:description: Heiress of the Lawrence family, Gianna couldn't believe it when she found her fiance had been cheating on her with her half-sister. Heartbroken, she went to get drunk in a bar, but ended up spending a passionate night with a hot guy named Logan. It was only until the next morning that she realized Logan was the owner of the Solomon Group and that she, under the influence, had signed a marriage contract with him.

video:video.video:title: The Virgin and The Billionaire
video:video.video:description: Desperate to save her dying mother, Cindy Parks strikes a deal with her boss’s daughter, Nikki Jenkins: Pretend to be Nikki and give her virginity to billionaire Charles Kane. Nikki uses the scheme to trick Charles into marrying her but when she gets sick, Cindy is once again forced to play dress up and step in as a replacement bride.

video:video.video:title: Crush on the Unwanted Princess
video:video.video:description: My world turned upside down when I was asked to go undercover, posing as a poor student dating a prince. Twists, secrets, and a crime syndicate later, I find out the truth is far more shocking than I could have imagined—I'm indeed a PRINCESS!

video:video.video:title: How to Tame a Silver Fox [English]
video:video.video:description: Harper Reeves is just trying to finish up her senior year of Yale without being a completely friendless loser. However, when her party's suddenly crashed by her dad's best friend and mysterious business partner, Chris Collins, she realizes she'd much rather have been busted by the cops. Chris, always in over-protective mode, gets on Harper's nerves, until she realizes he needs to go. Together with her best friend Maria, she brainstorms Operation Seduction, planning to get Chris to fall in love with her so her dad will kick him out himself. But every time Chris saves Harper from trouble, she gets closer to realizing she may have feelings for him after all.

video:video.video:title: All I Want Is You
video:video.video:description: Rosalie, a brave violinist, saves Damien from bullies in high school, leaving him with a cherished bracelet as a token. Ten years later, fate reunites them through a contract marriage orchestrated by Damien’s grandfather. Despite their initial clashes and misunderstandings, their bond deepens as Damien searches for his long-lost savior, unaware Rosalie is Rory. Betrayal, jealousy, and danger test their relationship, but love prevails when Damien discovers the truth. Their journey from resentment to passion culminates in a heartfelt reunion proving destiny's unbreakable ties.

video:video.video:title: The Heiress Strikes Back
video:video.video:description: Amelia Everhart has been a maid her whole life, until she realizes she’s the long-lost heiress of the Keller family, the most powerful family in LA. However, her evil-stepsister steals her identity and her 3 brothers kick her out. Now, she’s risen up from the ashes – and she vows to take her sweet sweet revenge.

video:video.video:title: The Back of the Unwanted Bride
video:video.video:description: “One night shattered her perfect life; a decade later, she returns with a billionaire's secret son and rewrites her destiny."

video:video.video:title: The Rejected Luna Returns with a Son
video:video.video:description: Sia returns with her son five years after divorcing Alpha Reagon, only to find that--Reagon never divorced her and he hates her! Reagon makes Sia work as a stripper, believing that she betrayed him five years ago. Reagon may be able to force himself to punish her, he cannot force himself to stop loving her. If only Reagon knew that Sia loves him, and that her son is actually his...

video:video.video:title: Divorce to Be the Top Heiress
video:video.video:description: Julia almost lost her life for her husband Klaus. However, she discovered that Klaus had cheated and had a child with another woman. Disheartened, she divorce and reclaim her true identity as the granddaughter of the worlds richest man...Klaus had always deeply loved Julia. He thought Julia had fallen for another man, so he deliberately pretended to cheat and got a divorce, giving her freedom. However, he could never truly let her go in his heart...

video:video.video:title: Adored by the CEO
video:video.video:description: Adrian Reeves was in desperate need of money due to family pressure. In pursuit of a high-paying job, she disguised herself as a man and became the special assistant to the CEO of a Fortune 500 company. The CEO, Raymond Shaw, was constantly pressured by his grandmother to get married, which led him to hire a male special assistant to prevent his grandmother from arranging various women as his personal secretary. But the CEO doesn’t know that his special assistant was actually a woman.And thus, began a comical love story…

video:video.video:title: Ignition: Return of the Drift King
video:video.video:description: Former racing legend Chase Walker has lived under the radar as a humble mechanic in countryside for five years. However, the Raptor Riders shows up, challenging the locals to a high-stakes race. With the town’s future at stake, Chase must decide: stay hidden or dust off his skills for one last ride. Can the washed-up champion outdrive his past—and save their home?

video:video.video:title: Get into Bed with My Husband's Best Friend
video:video.video:description: On her way home one day, Bella discovered that her husband Luis was having sex with his step-sister Caroline in the car. So she made up her mind to take revenge on Luis. With the help of her best friend, she approached Adrian, Luis's best friend and also his rival...

video:video.video:title: A Matter of Sin and Love
video:video.video:description: Ten years ago Christian adopted the enemy's daughter Elena. Ten years later, they fell in love with each other.

video:video.video:title: Ms. Janitor Turned CEO
video:video.video:description: The female CEO disguises herself as a janitor to inspect the company, but little did she expect to be bullied by the manager. The manager dirties her clothes and even slaps her, threatening to fire her. In that moment, she takes off her coat and reveals a VIP card, saying, Take a good look at who I am. Who will be the one getting fired? You!

video:video.video:title: The Bride of the Wolf King
video:video.video:description: My husband, the Wolf King, even if you don’t recognize me after the reincarnation, I will still find you and fall in love with you.

video:video.video:title: No Escape From My Ruthless Alpha
video:video.video:description: "I only want her. She's my mate."Ella, a wolf-less maid, is forced to marry the ruthless Alpha Logan instead of her sister. She soon discovers that Logan is her mate and that he's not as bad as everyone says. As she falls in love with him, Ella finds out she's actually a royal princess...

video:video.video:title: The Alpha King Is My Second Mate
video:video.video:description: Sasha is about to wed Alpha Spencer, but she’s rejected at the altar. As soon as Spencer makes her a slave, the handsome and powerful Alpha King Xander saves her and says he is her second mate! Poor Sasha can't believe it and she only wants to flee. But the Alpha King spoils her like a princess. She can’t help but fall in love with him. However, the Moon Goddess must be playing a joke on Sasha--Xander has vowed to kill Sasha’s kind because of the power she has.

video:video.video:title: Return of the Lady CEO
video:video.video:description: Rich family Neil’s favorite daughter Catherine was drugged to have sex with a stranger, which was considered a disgrace to the family integrity. After being disinherited by her father, Catherine found out her own sister Renee and fiance Howard were behind all these to set her up and she was then pushed off the roof by them. Eight years later, Catherine came back to the city alive becoming lady CEO of a company to seek for revenge from her enemies. To promise her son a loving family, Catherine contract-married with the stranger father, George Donton, a powerful royal family heir but mistakenly taken as a pizza delivery driver by her. With the discreet help from the Donton family, and a dangerous accident that George saved her life, Catherine finally found out the truth about him and decided to love him with her heart. They joined hands to beat the evils over and restored the peace to the city...

video:video.video:title: Love Never Fades
video:video.video:description: Su Ye was framed by Su Ling, the adopted daughter of the Su family, and had a one-night stand with Qin Chongzhou, the president of the Qin family. Five years later, she returned with her children. She must make those enemies pay the price!

video:video.video:title: Love Again, My Princess
video:video.video:description: In my previous life, I mistrusted my driver’s son, who stole my money with his evil girlfriend and injected HIV into me!!! Now I’m reborn back to school, I will make him taste all the pain he’s given me, expose him in front of everyone for the crap he’s done, and get back in love with my handsome admirer, NYC’s top billionaire!

video:video.video:title: Found a Homeless Lycan to Be My Mate
video:video.video:description: To escape Vincent’s harassment, Isabella holds a tournament to find a strong warrior to marry. Unexpectedly, an unknown rogue named Ethan, accompanied by his daughter Lily, wins the competition and becomes Isabella’s mate. But Ethan is not just any rogue. He is Lycan.After the two switch roles, Vincent launches a surprise attack, forcing Isabella into a desperate battle. In order not to burden Ethan and Lily, Isabella chooses to face Vincent alone, but is quickly overwhelmed and faces imminent danger. At the critical moment, Ethan then easily defeats Vincent—becoming the hero who saves the damsel in distress.

video:video.video:title: Desired by the Billionaire Football Star
video:video.video:description: A billionaire NFL quarterback star issues a nationwide manhunt for the woman he had a one-night stand with.

video:video.video:title: Love by Confinement
video:video.video:description: Ava was sent to prison by Liam for causing the death of his friend. After being released, Ava was tortured by Liam and her love for him was tested to its limits, yet little did she know, Liam also endured incredible agony. In the end, the couple let go of their grievances and started a new life together.

video:video.video:title: My Quintuplets Have Four Dads
video:video.video:description: An ordinary girl accidentally saved a CEO. No one knew about the romance, but her identity was taken away by her gold-digging girlfriend. Afterwards, she was blessed with five babies! These genius babies became the fuse of love.

video:video.video:title: Mr. Williams! Madame Is Dying
video:video.video:description: Madison Evans loved Hunter Williams for 16 years, but was asked to be his mobile blood bank for White Moonlight, Andrea David. Hunter Williams destroyed her family, just to make room for Andrea David. A cancer physical examination report made Madison Evans see his cold-blooded and ruthless true face. When she finally didn't love Hunter Williams, she found that she had been infatuated with the wrong person for 16 years.

video:video.video:title: My Ex-Wife Is a Superwoman
video:video.video:description: She was everything I thought I understood—my wife, my partner, my equal. But after the divorce, I realized how little I truly knew about her. Behind the quiet strength she displayed during our marriage lies an extraordinary world I never imagined. As a renowned figure with unparalleled talents and a heart devoted to justice, she’s not just a woman but a force to be reckoned with. Watching her thrive from a distance, I can’t help but feel a mix of admiration, regret, and longing. She’s my ex-wife, but to the world, she’s a superwoman—and I’m still hopelessly in her orbit.

video:video.video:title: The Female CEO Turned Janitor
video:video.video:description: Who would have thought that the cleaning lady before our eyes is actually a female CEO with a net worth of trillions...

video:video.video:title: Prisoner of Love
video:video.video:description: Jason, new at Berlin Schwingert High, intrigued Joe. Joe, unaware he fell for a boy, felt drawn to Jasons depth. They discussed freedom and frequented their secret rooftop. Meanwhile, Joe, an avid chess player, bonded with an online opponent, whom he mistakenly assumed was a girl, sharing his feelings with Barron.

video:video.video:title: Modern Journey of an Ancient Queen
video:video.video:description: Heely White was the Queen of middle age married to King Louis. Then one day King Louis killed Count White and queen Heely because the king thought the count was a threat to himself! Kill them to avoid future danger! To his surprise, Heely died and traveled a thousand years later to a woman in the United States with the same name, Heely, and the same face. So Queen Heely came to the modern age and began her new life.

video:video.video:title: Flash Marriage with my Alpha
video:video.video:description: Pregnant and rejected by my alpha mate. Today I had my first one night stand. It wasn't planned. It was also with a complete stranger. As I lay in bed, I paused when a familiar sense washed over me. The other side, my boyfriend, Ethan, was nearby, and he wasn't alone.You are so tight, girl, Only for you...

video:video.video:title: Revenge on my ex-husband
video:video.video:description: My ex-husband must die

video:video.video:title: I Can Never be Yours
video:video.video:description: When fresh-faced college graduate Sheryl Davis has a one-night stand with billionaire Liam Anderson on New Years Eve, she never expects to become his secretary – or watch him mistake her best friend for his mystery woman! As their office chemistry sizzles, Sheryl discovers shes pregnant! Will Liam realize his perfect match has been right in front of him all along?

video:video.video:title: Legally Bound To Love
video:video.video:description: The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

video:video.video:title: Lycan Princess Won't Be Your Luna
video:video.video:description: Alyssa, the lost princess of the powerful Obsidian Pack, awakens her hidden Lycan heritage after surviving a brutal attack. For years, she endured humiliation as the wolfless Luna of the Silver Moon Pack, married to Alpha Alaric in a contract to stabilize his cursed pack. When she discovers Alaric’s betrayal—his pregnant mistress and his family’s disdain—Alyssa leaves, reclaiming her royal identity. Reunited with her brother, the Lycan King, she uncovers a witchcraft conspiracy that suppressed her and Alaric’s powers. As they confront their past and a vengeful witch, Alyssa must choose between reclaiming her love or forging her own path as a leader. A tale of betrayal, destiny, and fierce redemption.

video:video.video:title: Return of that Banished Girl
video:video.video:description: Isabella grew up in a patriarchal home where she and her sister were mistreated in favor of their brother. Despite the odds, she got into Harvard but was forced to quit. With her mother’s help, she left, finished school, and became CEO. When she learned her family planned to marry off her sister to fund her brother’s marriage, she returned to save her mother and sister—this time, determined to fight back.

video:video.video:title: Reborn to Revenge: The Betrayed Luna
video:video.video:description: Melinda encountered Phillips and Laura, restraining her urge to confront them. She bumped into Nelson, who realized she was his Mate. Nelson's longing for her overwhelmed him as she walked away, leaving him in a maddening heartbeat.

video:video.video:title: Becoming My Ex’s Mother in Law
video:video.video:description: After serving six years in prison for her boyfriend's crime, Crystal is released only to discover her boyfriend's betrayal: he's engaged to the billionaire Governor's daughter, leaving Crystal heartbroken. Determined to take back her life, Crystal starts an exciting journey dating the Governor and becoming her ex's mother in-law. As their romance unfolds, Crystal finds herself deeply falling for the Governor, despite their fourteen-year-old age gap. Will she choose revenge or follow her heart in this unlikely romcom twist?

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Right Person, Wrong Time
video:video.video:description: When the love was so deep that it was difficult to separate, in order to save her mother, she was forced to appear in court and gave false testimony, sending the person she loved most to jail. Now that you are the CEO, there is a huge difference between us. But the flame of love was ignited again.

video:video.video:title: The Day I Heard His Heart Speak
video:video.video:description: Gemma Snow has secretly loved Elliot Ziegler for years. One day, an arranged marriage makes her dream come true. However, after Elliot abandons Gemma on their wedding night, she grows disheartened. Soon, their loveless three-year marriage pushes her toward divorce. Misled into believing he loves someone else, Gemma decides to let go—until she hears his thoughts at an unexpected moment.

video:video.video:title: Head Over Heels With My Substitute Wifey
video:video.video:description: Due to a reckless incident where Grace White's younger sister, Amber White, drove under the influence, Woods Group CEO Richard Woods' sister, Alice Woods, has fallen into a coma. Grace's father and malicious stepmother hold her mother's funeral urn hostage, coercing her to marry Richard Woods in Alice's stead to make up for that incident. Little do they know that Grace has already shared an intimate encounter with Richard previously.

video:video.video:title: Pick up a Billionaire Husband
video:video.video:description: On the eve of the wedding day, Casey finds her fiancé's affair with her half-sister, who's in her wedding dress for the next day! Left high and dry, to ensure her wedding proceeds as scheduled, she impulsively flashes a marriage to a hot stranger, whom she accidentally saves when he's in crisis. Casey, like everyone else, believes her contract husband is just an ordinary person. Two strangers' lives collide with sparks.

video:video.video:title: Nikita: Alpha Kings 3-Time Rejected Mate
video:video.video:description: Nikita, a she-wolf from the poorest, weakest New Moon Pack, unexpectedly became the destined mate of the newly appointed Alpha King Vincent Spencer the day after her boyfriend betrayed her. Having been rejected three times before, Nikita had lost faith in love. She wanted to refuse Alpha King Vincent, but he adamantly disagreed. He recognized her as his savior and had fallen for her at first sight.Simultaneously, Nikita discovered that her parents had been brutally murdered, and their killer was hiding within the wealthiest, most powerful Full Moon Pack under Vincents rule. In order to avenge her parents, Nikita reluctantly agreed to become Alpha King Vincents mate and infiltrate the Full Moon Pack for investigation. Thus began a journey of love and bloodshed...

video:video.video:title: Beyond Home: The Billion-Dollar Inheritance
video:video.video:description: Mu Wanwan, the fake daughter of the Mu Group, was kicked out of the house by her adoptive parents, and her boyfriend of many years also abandoned her. When she was down and out, she was taken in by the Ye family's grandma, and she met Ye, the president of the Ye Group...

video:video.video:title: The Wallflower And The Alphas
video:video.video:description: Avery Williams is a high school senior wallflower and a transforming werewolf who has two identities inside. One is a wolf, the other is a Veela. Avery tries to handle her werewolf instinct, especially as the approaching mating time drives her out of control.

video:video.video:title: Not His ATM, I'm The Wolf Queen
video:video.video:description: After five years as Nathaniel’s family’s personal ATM, Luna Scarlett finally walks away when he chooses his childhood sweetheart over her. She rescues a rogue who’s secretly the Lycan King, and rises to power — while Nathaniel loses everything and begs for her return.

video:video.video:title: Intern's Secret: CEO's Spouse
video:video.video:description: Huo Yunting, is a young and promising leader of Huo family, known for his keen business sense and decisive decision-making. A chance, he hurried through the corridor, inadvertently and intern Lin shallow pass by. Huo Yunting's heart suddenly a flutter, that familiar and slightly green face, is his day and night thinking of his wife - Lin shallow. Originally, in order to give him a surprise, but also in order to more in-depth understanding of his world, Lin shallow decided to hide the identity, with an ordinary intern attitude to join the Huo Group. After learning the truth, Huo Yunting mood mixed. On the one hand, he was moved by Lin Shallow's courage and determination, and was willing to put down his comfortable life and stand beside him with a new attitude; On the other hand, he also worried that this sudden "closeness" would cause her unnecessary stress and distress.

video:video.video:title: The CEO's Secret Love
video:video.video:description: Fifteen years ago, Gu Junxu met a girlBut when she appeared in front of him many years later, he...

video:video.video:title: Too Late to Regret, Ex-Hubby
video:video.video:description: Olivia Sterling lived in a loveless marriage with her cold and arrogant husband, James Sterling, for seven years. During this period, she witnessed her son Henry being gradually taken away by James ex - girlfriend, Victoria Clark. Olivia became an outsider. At Henrys birthday party, Olivia found herself completely ignored, and then proposed divorce that night. After leaving the cage named marriage, Olivia picked up her work as a talented translator of Joyce again and became closer with her friends brother, Tom Whitmore. At this time, James and son Henry wanted to win Olivia back, but found that the woman who was once regarded as insignificant by them was now out of their reach.

video:video.video:title: Fated to My Bad Boy Alpha
video:video.video:description: Abigail, a wolfless orphan, never expected that her mate would be Alpha Axel—the most infamous playboy in school.Just as they fall in love and start planning their future, Axel's ex-girlfriend returns, claiming she’s pregnant with his child……

video:video.video:title: Taming My Billionaire's Ruthless Desire
video:video.video:description: Jade Garrison, once the adopted daughter of the wealthy Garrison family, faces betrayal and cruelty after the return of Olivia, the biological daughter. Framed and abandoned by her husband, Samuel Fisher, Jade leaves with their unborn child. Five years later, she returns to save her son but is forced into servitude by Samuel. As secrets unravel—Olivia’s manipulations, Samuel’s hidden love, and Jade’s true lineage as the lost heiress of the Carey family—their painful past collides with a chance for redemption. A tale of love, revenge, and forgiveness, where scars heal only when pride falls.

video:video.video:title: Love, Lost and Found
video:video.video:description: Mia Sanders, a kind-hearted young woman, has been labeled as a jinx by her family from the day she was born. Not only does her father treat her as if she's invisible, but even the household servants look down on her. In stark contrast, her twin sister, Molly Sanders, is the favored one. Molly subjects Mia to ceaseless mistreatment and oppression, and Mia can only endure it. She holds onto the belief that she can escape this life once she grows up and moves out.

video:video.video:title: Never Mess with Mom
video:video.video:description: She, a quiet laborer toiling tirelessly on a construction site. All she wanted was to give her daughter a normal, peaceful life. But when her daughter was humiliated, bullied, and finally kidnapped at the prestigious school, her rage ignited. The once-invincible warrior who once shook the world, after twelve years in hiding, returned for her daughter! In a single night, the four great families bowed in submission, the underground organization The Mafia was obliterated, and even the Russian mob trembled in terror! They finally understood…The most fearsome wrath does not belong to the powerful and influential—but to a mother who would tear the world apart for her daughter! This is a mothers battlefield. Now betrayed she returns to reclaim it all!

video:video.video:title: My Unwanted Billionaire Ex
video:video.video:description: On her wedding day, she claims to be pregnant with aother man's child, forcing her fiancé to leave in humiliation. Three years later, she meets him again, now the richest man in Los Angeles. Overwhelmed with shame, she avoids him but ends up having a drunken one-night stand before fleeing in panic. Believing their story has reached its end, she is astounded to find out that her new boss and landlord are none other than her former fiancé. Will this lead to revenge, or can their love be rekindled?

video:video.video:title: Stolen Heiress, Unstolen Love
video:video.video:description: Rebecca, a secret billionaire heiress, turned down an marriage to a powerful tycoon for her boyfriend of 10 years—only to catch him cheating with her best friend right in the office. The two, thinking they outranked her, subjected Rebecca to ruthless workplace bullying. Finally, she tossed her black card and revealed her true identity as their big boss, the two kneel in regret, begging for forgiveness. Meanwhile, Leonardo, the suitor Rebecca rejected, infiltrates the company to investigate his fiancée. Will he be able to recognize Rebecca? And can they finally fulfill their unfinished marriage?

video:video.video:title: Don't Fall in Love with Me, Husband
video:video.video:description: An impulsive marriage and a passionate one-night stand tie designer Nora and billionaire Ted together. As past traumas resurface, they realize their fates have been entwined for years. Can they bridge their class divide, battle hidden enemies, and protect their love?

video:video.video:title: Married a Secret Millionaire as a Substitute
video:video.video:description: In order to pay for her mother's medical expenses, Olivia Walker, the illegitimate child of the Walker family, marries a poor ex-convict in place of her sister. She has no idea that this man is, in fact, Andrew Smith, the richest person in Cascadia. Their lives then take a sweet but dangerous turn.

video:video.video:title: I'm Nothing but a Mortal (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Ian Colt, a genius Jade Sect apprentice, ascends to the Sky Realm after just 20 years of cultivation. Believing there's nothing more to teach him, his mentor, Sean Judd, tricks Ian into leaving for the mortal realm.There, Ian encounters Jim Cole, whose life is on the line. Despite the efforts of three skilled doctors, none can save him, leaving his daughter, Sue Cole, desperate. Ian successfully saves Jim.

video:video.video:title: Her Vengeful Rebirth Before the Tempests
video:video.video:description: Louisa Ford is the neglected eldest daughter of the Ford family of Danesia who is given over to a farming family because her grandmother deems her as a sign of bad luck. Raised and doted on by her adoptive family, at the age of five, Louisa meets Paul Hale, a skilled doctor, on a mountain and becomes Paul’s disciple, learning peak medical techniques with all her effort.

video:video.video:title: CEO, Your Wife Runs Away with Your Six Heirs
video:video.video:description: After a night of passion, Evelyn Tomas gives birth to sextuplets. Six years later, a lovely boy stops billionaire Ethan Huntington and hands him a paternity test paper. He corners her and forces her to give him the child.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping for 30 years, My Brothers Kneel for me
video:video.video:description: Adopted by the Grayson family, May once enjoyed the love of three overprotective older brothers and the warmth of a happy home. However, after the Grayson family’s biological daughter Stella returned, May was treated as a “stand-in” and suffered betrayal and coldness. Misunderstandings and repeated emotional wounds left her heartbroken and disillusioned. Eventually, she volunteered to become a test subject in the “The May Project,” choosing to go into deep sleep for thirty years ...

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] Wed to the Unknown Heir
video:video.video:description: After her father had an affair and her mother passed away, Clara's stepmother moved in with her illegitimate son, throwing Clara into a world of trouble. The scheming stepmother wanted her own son to study abroad, so she pressured Clara to drop out of school and get married, using the dowry to fund her son's education. But Clara, determined not to give up on her dreams, took on all sorts of part-time jobs. One day, she saved an elderly lady, and through a twist of fate, ended up marrying the woman's grandson. Clara was ready to keep working hard to support herself, only to find out her new husband was actually a super-rich tycoon pretending to be a poor employee! Deciding to play along with his charade, a hilarious and absurd drama ensued!

video:video.video:title: Twins on Board: Mom, Your Cover is Blown
video:video.video:description: In the maternity ward, she had a difficult labor and hemorrhaged, but her newlywed husband told the doctor with a sneer: I don't want any of the big ones or the small ones! Three years later, she returned with her budding baby, abused the scum of the earth and then realized: what?

video:video.video:title: Sinful Love With Alphas
video:video.video:description: Adea, a prophetic female werewolf, navigates her dreams sensual mysteries. Encountering her persistent stepbrother Shane at Half Moons den, intrigue ensues. Amidst Shanes pursuit, the arrival of stepfather Joshua and his wife unravels hidden truths. A tale of desire, secrets, and family bonds awaits.

video:video.video:title: (Dubbed)The Beggar King’s Bride
video:video.video:description: During a bridal ball toss, two sisters cast their destinies into the air. The elder’s ball lands with a nobleman; the younger’s, in the hands of a beggar. One rises to glory. The other dies in regret—until time turns back. Given a second chance, the younger sister rewrites the moment. But what if the beggar holds a secret, and fate has its own design?

video:video.video:title: Hollywood Staged Romance Live 24/7
video:video.video:description: Ruby, a rookie actress, faces career turmoil when frozen out by her company, then creates a sensation by drunkenly kissing Charles, the Spike Group CEO. He offers her a love contract: a fake relationship to promote his brands. With director Federico's aid, Ruby becomes an overnight sensation, showcasing her true self. Despite the facade, Charles and Ruby's feelings become real. Ruby later discovers Charles had been searching for her for six years, leading to unexpected revelations.

video:video.video:title: Princess Consort Jiaojiao
video:video.video:description: Shui Luolan was forced to marry the good-for-nothing prince at the beginning! The prince can’t take care of himself? Don't be afraid, Luo Lan can serve him. The prince is paralyzed in bed? Don't be afraid, Luo Lan travels with the operating room to treat him.

video:video.video:title: The Divorced Heiress Claims Her Crown
video:video.video:description: Caroline, the beloved heiress of the Donovan family and sister to three protective brothers, was born into a life of privilege. But for love, she concealed her identity and married Hayden, quietly supporting his rise for three years.Until betrayal struck — during a life-threatening childbirth, Hayden chose to save another woman’s child over hers. Heartbroken but resolute, Caroline divorced him, took her daughter, and began to rebuild her life. Now, Hayden must face the painful road to winning her back.

video:video.video:title: Masked, Mighty, Mine (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Refusing an arranged marriage, Jill Stork enters a contract marriage with a mysterious male model who protects her in secret while she seeks revenge. Little does she know, behind the mask of the penniless model hides Zac Quinn, ruler of a peerless business empire who supports her every decision—and will soon prove she has always been his one and only choice with a one-of-a-kind grand wedding.

video:video.video:title: The Beggar King’s Bride
video:video.video:description: During a bridal ball toss, two sisters cast their destinies into the air. The elder’s ball lands with a nobleman; the younger’s, in the hands of a beggar. One rises to glory. The other dies in regret—until time turns back. Given a second chance, the younger sister rewrites the moment. But what if the beggar holds a secret, and fate has its own design?

video:video.video:title: Seduce My Ex's Brother-in-Law
video:video.video:description: After heartbreak and family collapse, piano teacher Emily is forced into the world of the elite to save her father. An unexpected encounter with Ethan,the sharp and enigmatic lawyer of the Hawthorne family, leads them to pose as lovers.But as trials, secrets, and betrayals surface, their staged romance grows dangerously real. Emily must summon courage and wit to fight back against the forces determined to destroy her family and future.

video:video.video:title: Daddy’s Kisses? No Thanks!
video:video.video:description: She and he met unexpectedly. Six years later, he was looking for his son, and her relationship with him warmed up in the company group. After all the twists and turns, can the little baby return to his father?

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Destiny's Keeper
video:video.video:description: He was clearly the strongest man in the world, yet he was mistaken for a beggar

video:video.video:title: Second Life, the Godfather's Wife
video:video.video:description: During the appointment ceremony for the leader of the Moretti family, Eleanor's fiancé Lucian assassinated the leader, while Eleanor's sister Vivian was jealous of her sister and killed Eleanor, both of whom died. Ten years ago, they chose the day of their fiancé and lived a new life. Eleanor only wanted to live an ordinary life and chose to marry a beggar, while Vivian married Lucian. Unexpectedly, the beggar whom Vivian initially sneered at was actually the renowned Godfather. After enduring hardships, Eleanor finally became Godfather's Wife.

video:video.video:title: Please, Marry My Husband
video:video.video:description: Clara devoted twenty years to her husband and raised his two children, only to be betrayed by them all. Her husband plans a wedding—with her best friend as the bride, her own children standing by their side. Broken and humiliated, Clara decides to disappear, leaving behind a severance letter and a box filled with secrets—proof of everything they’ve done to her. But just when they think she’s gone for good, the wedding is interrupted by the one person they never expected to return. Love, guilt, and revenge explode in this twisted story of betrayal and rebirth.

video:video.video:title: God of Wrath
video:video.video:description: Based on the novel by Rina Kent. Good-girl university student Cecily Knight has spent years pining after popular golden boy Landon King. But everything changes when she impulsively saves Jeremy Volkov: Brutal mafia heir, Landon's deadliest rival, and the one man who will stop at nothing to make Cecily his. As Landon's manipulation is slowly exposed and Jeremy's relentless pursuit awakens something dark in Cecily she never knew existed, she must choose between the boy she thought she wanted and the dangerous man she can't stop craving.

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] Goodbye, My Former Love
video:video.video:description: Ella concealed her identity and spent four years married to Ash, yet it proved insufficient to withstand the allure of a first love. Consequently, despite being seven months pregnant, Ella had to endure a harrowing Cesarean section. Leaving behind a divorce agreement, Ella reclaimed her status as the heiress of a wealthy family, driving Ash to the brink of insanity.

video:video.video:title: I can hear you
video:video.video:description: She lost her hearing because of him, but he doesn't know the truth.

video:video.video:title: The Foolish Godly Son-in-Law
video:video.video:description: Ye Chen, having dispelled all his cultivation, returns to ten years ago, reversing time for another chance, all to protect his wife comprehensively. After five years of playing the fool, Ye Chen awakens one day and is revered as the "Stock God" following a stock trading contest. With his ability to foresee the future, he is eagerly sought after by the magnates and tycoons.

video:video.video:title: Chasing My Frozen Wife
video:video.video:description: On her mother’s funeral day, Amber discovered her husband’s betrayal. After seven years of pursuit and fifty proposals, their marriage crumbled under lies and neglect. On their anniversary, heartbroken, she chose to freeze herself —leaving behind only her husbands bitter regret and unbearable remorse.

video:video.video:title: My Stubborn CEO
video:video.video:description: The mute girl was sent to the CEO's bed as a gift. After marriage, everyone thought he was ashamed to take her out, but little did they know he was completely enamored by her and doted on her endlessly!

video:video.video:title: Fall Into Sweet Trap [English]
video:video.video:description: A contract marriage, two hearts drawing closer. Caitlin, struggling to survive office politics and her ex-husband's betrayal. Simon, tasked with revitalizing his family's business. When fate leads them into a loveless marriage, will they continue to abide by the contract or bravely pursue their true feelings?

video:video.video:title: Punch me baby
video:video.video:description: Daisy, the main character, had been married to her husband, Kelvin, for years but remained childless. Unwilling to reveal his azoospermia, Kelvin secretly arranged for a sperm donor to get her pregnant. Meanwhile, Daisy struggled with her mother’s serious illness and Kelvin’s infidelity. One day, Daisy saved Rowan, the male protagonist, from a gangster’s attack, and he fell in love with her at first sight. Rowan secretly chose her as his contractual wife. When he discovered her pregnancy, he mistakenly believed she had been unfaithful. Heartbroken, he drowned his sorrows in alcohol, nearly giving the second female lead a chance to take Daisy’s place in his life. It wasn’t until Daisy was kidnapped that Rowan finally uncovered the truth—Daisy’s child was actually his. In the end, Rowan rescued her.

video:video.video:title: Never Meeting You After the Rain
video:video.video:description: After 7 years of hard work, the scumbag divorced her just to register Bai Yueguang's child? This time, she turned away in despair, and was later embraced by her childhood sweetheart and married in a wedding dress. The scumbag begged her to come back with red eyes, but she only said coldly, I don't love you anymore.

video:video.video:title: Against the Tide: A Youth Rewritten
video:video.video:description: Given a second chance at life, she was determined to rewrite her fate. First, she took her sisters and completely shook off their past identities as delinquents, resolutely breaking up with her incompatible boyfriend to start a brand-new life. By a stroke of luck, she saved someones life, and this person later took the initiative to offer tutoring to them, bringing a turning point to their academic pursuits.

video:video.video:title: Footprints of Fate: Tracing the Path Home (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: In a car accident, Kaleb Carter loses his memory due to injury. Thirteen years pass, and he is now working at Lacoy Group with his adopted daughter, Stella Carter. However, he offends William Lacoy and is bullied and humiliated. By coincidental circumstances, William discovers that Kaleb owns a lucky charm identical to the one his mother has. It turns out that Kaleb is the father William has been searching for, with 'Brandon Lacoy' being his real name.

video:video.video:title: CEO's Unexpected Bride
video:video.video:description: To fulfill a promise to his grandfather, Su Luobai reluctantly prepares to propose to the wealthy Lan family's daughter, Lan Rouduo. Disguised as a poor man, Su is rejected by the family, only for Lan Yitong to step in and offer to marry him. As they marry, Lan Yitong pursues her dreams, and their relationship blossoms in unexpected ways.

video:video.video:title: Love in the Shadows
video:video.video:description: Sophie agrees to marry a stranger to save her family, believing he’s just a quiet, absent businessman. But her world is turned upside down when she discovers her husband is Robert Kensington, a powerful CEO with a dangerous reputation—and a family willing to betray him for control of his company. Pulled into explosive boardroom battles and shocking family secrets, Sophie finds herself in a world where love and survival are anything but guaranteed.

video:video.video:title: True Love on the Night of the Escaped Wedding
video:video.video:description: Wen Shuyao's scumbag fiancé Shen Yan escaped from the marriage. Wen Shuyao was heartbroken. A deliberate encounter happened. The boss who had been secretly in love with her for many years unexpectedly fell from the sky.

video:video.video:title: Handling the Super Dad
video:video.video:description: Unexpectedly, the boss of Dongyou Group turned out to be the father's younger brother. The female president was caught in a petroleum raw material crisis. The male protagonist made a phone call and asked the boss of Dongyou Group to take the contract and talk about it. All the problems were solved in five minutes.

video:video.video:title: Lost Love: The White Moonlight's Regret
video:video.video:description: Lu Fan, the son of the wealthiest man, finally married his white moonlight, Fang Yuqing. Lu Fan was extremely indulgent towards Fang Yuqing, even giving her a monthly allowance of up to one million. However, when Lu Fan fell ill, Fang Yuqing was unwilling to pay even a hundred thousand for his surgery. What's more, she told the doctor to give up on treating Lu Fan, who could have been saved, and even planned to sell his organs for money. All she wanted was to be with her white moonlight, Chen Jingkai, after Lu Fan's death. Chen Jingkai even revealed to Lu Fan that his parents' car accident was not an accident, but was orchestrated by them in order to seize the Lu family's fortune. After learning the truth, Lu Fan died of extreme anger. However, he was given a chance by fate to live his life over again. In this life, he would make them pay a hundredfold!

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] The Celestial Sovereign's Silent Vengeance
video:video.video:description: Cayden Freeman, the Celestial Sovereign of Azra, married Juliette Frost while concealing his identity and secretly supported the Frost family for three years. After intervening to save Alessia Walsh, the second daughter of the Walsh family, from trouble, he earned the enmity of Odin Wells, the Wells heir, and was simultaneously thrown out by Juliette. At an investment banquet, when Cayden faced false accusations and public anger, Alessia appeared and skillfully diffused the situation, marking the beginning of their relationship.

video:video.video:title: Chasing the Guilty Wife: The Indifferent CEO Knows
video:video.video:description: The maid Luo Wanwan turned around and became the wife of a wealthy family, but she was framed and killed by the male protagonist's biological eldest brother. She was tortured and escaped. Five years later, Luo Wanwan returned to China again to find out the truth of what happened back then. Her scumbag boyfriend also changed his feelings and finally led a happy life.

video:video.video:title: The Intern is the Undercover Boss
video:video.video:description: Don't underestimate the intern because you don't know her true identity. To investigate the truth behind a subsidiary's bullying scandal, CEO Claire goes undercover as an intern, enduring humiliation from the villains. With courage and ingenuity, she uncovers the truth, rebuffs the antagonists, and unexpectedly finds love in the process.

video:video.video:title: Throne and Kin
video:video.video:description: The Sterling family, led by Edward Sterling, is exposed for their involvement in power struggles and a grain monopoly conspiracy. Thomas Sterling conspires with Lord Ashford in a rebellion, leading to a rift between mother and son. Margaret Benson unveils their crimes and aids the common people, earning the support of His Majesty the Emperor. Her Majesty the Empress Dowager willingly steps down in disgrace. Ultimately, the Sterling family collapses, Lord Ashford's coup fails, and Margaret chooses to leave the palace, embracing a simple life. His Majesty the Emperor restores peace by quelling the unrest and reassuring the people

video:video.video:title: Drunken Sword: Conquer the Demon
video:video.video:description: Caleb Grant, Eva Croft, and allies seek revenge, uncovering a conspiracy involving the Surrey family and demon clans. They rescue Master Gale Croft, defend the Great Wall, and defeat the Surreys, with Eva ascending as the female emperor. Meanwhile, Drew Morris rejects an arranged marriage for Caleb, sparking new conflicts and adventures.

video:video.video:title: [Dubbed]Path Beyond Eternity
video:video.video:description: I love my school beauty wife very much, but I didn't expect that the male mistress would steal my wife! He even turned the tables and accused me of stealing her! Do you think you are rich? Do you want to see that I have a big boss grandfather? He has tens of billions of real estate! How dare you steal my wife!

video:video.video:title: The Wealthy Madame's Top Healer
video:video.video:description: The most beautiful girl in Lunan actually wants to marry Qin Feng! What magical ability does he have that not only wins the favor of the rich woman, but also makes the powerful bow down?

video:video.video:title: My Crazy Debut as a Villainess
video:video.video:description: After getting hit on the head, Selena Logan woke up to find herself inside the very CEO romance novel she had been reading. Now, she was a spoiled heiress from the capital's elite circle, known for being love-obsessed and hopelessly naive.Her home life consisted of a scheming cousin and three dangerously powerful brothers.On day one, things went off-script: she accidentally drank the love potion meant for her cousin Yasmin and ended up in a chaotic one-night stand with a mysterious man.They met again at a lavish birthday banquet. To her horror, that stranger turned out to be Louis Johnson — the cold, untouchable heir of the Johnson family.What had started as a mistake turned into a deliciously sweet and chaotic game of cat and mouse. This "villainess" might just have stolen the whole show.

video:video.video:title: CEO Wants My Little Rascal
video:video.video:description: Years after a one-night stand, she returns with a child—love reignites, and secrets unfold......

video:video.video:title: Uncle Richard is My Baby Daddy
video:video.video:description: Jocelyn was killed after catching her husband Colton cheating on her with her half-sister. Miraculously, God gave her a second chance and sent her back to the moment she was proposed to three years ago. This time she wouldn't let them get away with it, but she didn't expect to find herself pregnant with a baby from Colton's uncle, Richard Asher.

video:video.video:title: Maid’s Vendetta
video:video.video:description: 20 years ago, Diana, the daughter of a wealthy family, had an enviable happy life. However, due to the intervention of her tutor Sophie, Dianas father derailed, her brother died unexpectedly, her mother became insane, and her happy family was shattered because of one woman. She vowed to make Sophie feel the pain of losing everything. 20 years later, she changed her name to Raven and entered Sophies house as a maid, starting her revenge...

video:video.video:title: Her Cold-hearted Alpha
video:video.video:description: Kiara, a weak Omega with night blindness and no wolf is dumped by her pack, and sodecides to promote herself to a stronger wolf with Alpha King Alejandro’s training, andmeanwhile, they step into an adventurous relationship journey.

video:video.video:title: One Move God Mode 2
video:video.video:description: One Move God Mode 2

video:video.video:title: False Weakling, True Power
video:video.video:description: False Weakling, True Power

video:video.video:title: MOVE ASIDE! IM THE EX BEYOND YOUR REACH!
video:video.video:description: Olivia and Derek die in a car crash on their way to divorce and are reborn as students. Seven years later, Olivia marries billionaire Asher, but a reunion with Derek and Jennifer leads to bullying and humiliation. Can Olivia fight back and take her revenge?

video:video.video:title: Spoiled By The Alpha King With Her Triplets
video:video.video:description: Six years ago, Sister Alicia broke her vows to save a dying werewolf, and was cast out of the Church for carrying his child. Now she slips into the Alpha Estate with her son, a wolf pup carrying royal blood, unaware that the ruthless Alpha King is the boy's father. For six years he has searched for the woman who saved him, while the aging Old Wolf King grows desperate for a pureblood heir. Neither knows she is right under their noses, raising the very heir they've been looking for.

video:video.video:title: Code of the Heiress
video:video.video:description: Legendary hacker Claire hides as a housewife but is betrayed. After divorce, she marries mysterious Daniel to take revenge and uncover her family’s dark past. Can she find truth—and true love?

video:video.video:title: The Betrayed Guardian: The Empire Begs Him Back
video:video.video:description: For ten years, Arthur stood alone against the Abyss. But the new Empress Valeria fell for a pack of lies and branded him a fraud, leaving the entire Empire to despise him. And that’s when the Archfiends emerged from the Abyss.

video:video.video:title: The Triplets' Final Regret
video:video.video:description:
Elisa, a half-human, half-vampire girl, believes the Lockhart triplets are the only people in the world she can truly trust. She wants to become human for them—and spend forever with one of them.
But everything changes when Amber, the maid’s daughter, appears. Again and again, Elisa is abandoned, humiliated, and stripped of her dignity. All for Amber. Finally, she decides to let go and accept her fate: leaving day school behind, transferring to night school, and becoming a vampire.
But when Elisa appears in her night school uniform, held in the arms of a powerful vampire heir, why do the triplets who once threw her away suddenly fall into regret and panic—kneeling before her, begging for forgiveness?

video:video.video:title: The Long-Awaited Encounter
video:video.video:description: Six years ago, on the day of her coming-of-age ceremony, Janet Smith, the eldest daughter of the Smith family, found herself drugged by her father, Neo Smith, and her sister, Roxy Smith. In a daze, she unwittingly spent the night with Yael Lawley, the CEO of Lawley Corp. This scandal orchestrated by her own family led to Janet's expulsion from her home. Now, years have passed. What will transpire between Janet and Yael when they cross paths once more?

video:video.video:title: I Can Hear His Thoughts!
video:video.video:description: After saving a mysterious elderly woman's life, Hailey Summers is stunned to discover that she's been gifted a bizarre power — she can hear her boss Ryker's thoughts just by touching him! With this unexpected mind-reading ability, Hailey turns her failing career around and even wins her boss's heart. But when the power is suddenly taken away, will everything still be the same?

video:video.video:title: The Dragon King's Forbidden Maid
video:video.video:description: Maid Joanna conceives a dragon heir by King Atlas on the Night of the Lunar Eclipse. Queen Sophia scars her and jails her in the Tower of Oblivion, where she raises Louis. Louis saves the Queen Mother; Atlas recognizes the woman from six years ago. Sophia and her father Augustus forge the bloodline crystal and rebel. The Queen Mother exposes them, and Atlas crushes the rebels. Atlas crowns Joanna, who carries a second child.

video:video.video:title: The Holy Covenant Prophet
video:video.video:description:
Isora, a century-old demigoddess, sets out to reclaim twelve Sacred Covenants and seal the Abyss. Her journey takes her from a duke’s estate consumed by ambition to the shattered lands of Hawk and a northern fortress engulfed in eternal night. Along the way, she and the royal knight Seren go from bitter rivals to companions willing to die for each other.
When a prophecy foretells Seren’s brutal death for her sake, he steps in front of a blade to protect her. For the first time, Isora defies fate, forcing a Sacred Covenant into her beloved’s body to resurrect him and grant him extraordinary power. The two soon discover a vast conspiracy behind the Abyss’s awakening.
No longer slaves to prophecy, Isora and Seren seize control of their destiny. Rejecting the merciless pact of old, they advance together toward the heart of the Abyss. The nine remaining Sacred Covenants hold the key to ending the chaos and purging the darkness. Prophecy does not decide how their story ends—the human heart is the one force fate cannot predict.

video:video.video:title: Vengeance and Untold Love
video:video.video:description: Ethan mistakenly believed that Scarlett's father had killed his own father, leading him to confine Scarlett in a mental hospital, where she endured torment for two years. Later, Ethan, in an effort to thwart his stepmother Evelyn's scheme, chose to enter into a fake marriage with Scarlett, with a three-month deadline. However, just as Ethan and Scarlett received their marriage license, Ethan discovered the mysterious woman he had slept with, Sophia.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] La Vierge et le milliardaire
video:video.video:description: Désespérée de sauver sa mère mourante, Cindy Parks conclut un marché avec la fille de son patron, Nikki Jenkins : Se faire passer pour Nikki et donner sa virginité au milliardaire Charles Kane. Nikki utilise ce stratagème pour convaincre Charles de l’épouser, mais lorsqu’elle tombe malade, Cindy est une fois de plus obligée de se déguiser et de remplacer sa mère.

video:video.video:title: Hurt Me,Love Me
video:video.video:description: Even though Katherine and Eric got married, Eric was still entangled with Riley, which caused Katherine great suffering. Despite her pain, Katherine endured it out of guilt and deep love. Unexpectedly, she became pregnant again, but Eric continued to neglect and hurt her. For the sake of their lost child, Katherine decided to divorce.

video:video.video:title: The Sea God's Disguise: Fishing for Love
video:video.video:description: A boy once saved a god's life. Sixty years later, with his own life running out, that now old man begs the god for three more years. So the Sea God marries into the family in disguise, as nothing more than a fisherman. For three years he serves in silence while his wife looks right through him, still chasing an old flame who never deserved her. When the clock runs out, so does his patience — he tears up the contract and walks. Now she's the one left begging for a second chance.

video:video.video:title: The Tempted DILF Is My Professor
video:video.video:description: Tessa Holland, 21, has a secret she can barely admit to herself, she's fallen for her father's best friend, her own professor, Jared. She thought she could bury it forever, until one reckless night changes everything between them. When forbidden desire collides with loyalty, how long can their secret survive?

video:video.video:title: The Twins Love Me Too Late
video:video.video:description: For three years, Hannah slept beside a stranger — her husband's twin, Ansel — in a marriage built on Aiden's revenge scheme for Ivy. After her mother's death and a miscarriage, Hannah gets her revenge, cuts both brothers out of her life, and starts a new life overseas.

video:video.video:title: Don's Back: No One Touches His Daughter
video:video.video:description: Eighteen years ago, Leonardo Gambino ruled New York's underworld. At eighteen, he took control. By thirty-three, he survived a brutal war that buried half his brothers. That night, he learned his wife was pregnant—and for the first time, he had something greater than power: a family.So he walked away. He divided his fortune, abandoned his legend, and vanished with his wife and closest friend. Under a new name, he opened a small bar in a quiet town and built an ordinary life.Eighteen years later, no one recognizes the former Godfather in the gentle bartender. To his seventeen-year-old daughter Sofia, he is just Dad—a harmless man shielding her from his dark past.Then Sofia becomes the target of vicious bullies. Threatened and terrified, she lies to protect the father she believes is only a bartender. She has no idea what he used to be. Until Leonardo sees what they have done to her.Black cars arrive in the rain. Armed men emerge from shadows. Old soldiers bow before their Godfather. Luca stands at his side. And in the darkness, Dominic Gallo—believed dead—still lives.The Colombos think they have inherited his city. They are wrong. When the Gambino crest appears, Jack's arrogance crumbles. When hundreds answer one call, Jacob—once Leonardo's driver—realizes the truth: Leonardo did not disappear because he lost. He chose family over power. Now someone has hurt his daughter.Sofia watches in disbelief as her gentle father transforms. The bartender is gone. In his place stands the man who once made New York kneel—the Godfather whose name still commands fear and loyalty.Old enemies gather. Former allies return. The Colombos come for blood. Leonardo must decide how far he will go to protect the family he sacrificed everything to build. They have no idea they are touching the daughter of the Godfather.And when the man who made a city bow finally stops hiding—who will be left standing when his old name is spoken again?

video:video.video:title: From Small-Town Outcast to Blooming Rose
video:video.video:description: As a child loved by no one, Ava suffered unfathomable abuse from her father and grandmother. On the eve of being forced to marry a scoundrel, Ava managed to flee from home with her mother's help. Years later, Ava is now a powerful CEO and returns to rescue her mother, only to walk into her family's trap. But she's a victim no longer - this time, she's back to destroy them all and seize her long-awaited vengeance.

video:video.video:title: If I Can't Hear You
video:video.video:description: I was born with inferiority. Nothing but unfriendly laughters filled in my whole life. I have to welcome a rebirth, a true self of mine is about to bring my husband a truely mental torture.

video:video.video:title: Hidden in the Medal:My Million-Dollar Revenge
video:video.video:description: Nora devotes herself to caring for her gravely ill father. After his death, her mother, who has always favored her brother, joins forces with him and his wife to seize the multimillion-dollar estate. They leave Nora only an old military medal and pressure her to give up her inheritance. With nowhere left to turn, she discovers a secret hidden in the medal. Armed with evidence, Nora exposes her brother’s theft and legally reclaims the entire estate. Breaking free from her family’s favoritism, she carries her father’s love with her as she builds a career and turns her life around.

video:video.video:title: Surf God's Revenge
video:video.video:description: Duke is the secret god of his island home, and he loves surfing on his magic Koa wood board more than anything. But the powerful Sea Hag curses him and shrinks his board. To get it back, he has to stay married to Kai, the Sea Hag's human daughter, for 5 years. Duke helps Kai rise to stardom as a surfer, but Kai thinks Duke is just a worthless house husband. She mistreats him, and falls back in with her ex-boyfriend, a world famous surfer. When the five years are up and the curse is lifted, Duke must choose – stay with Kai and hope she recognizes his worth or divorce her and live life on his own terms?

video:video.video:title: Chosen by the Dragon Baby: His Human Mate
video:video.video:description: After been betrayed, sold, and robbed of her newborn, Emery believes she has lost everything. A year later, she enters the Palace of Alaric Pyrewind, the Dragon King, where his silent daughter Juno rejects every shifter—but chooses Emery as “Mama.” As Juno begins to heal and Alaric falls for Emery, buried secrets reveal that their bond runs deeper than any of them imagined.

video:video.video:title: The Heiress' Return: Three Brothers at Her Beck and Call
video:video.video:description: Refusing to settle for mediocrity within her esteemed family, Mia Gale, daughter of the affluent Gale family, rejects the indulgent lifestyle offered by her three brothers. Instead, she opts to pursue her own path, determined to carve out success through hard work and dedication.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé] Jusqu'à ce que la Ruse nous Unis
video:video.video:description:
Margaux, la meilleure experte en gestion de crises, a secrètement aimé le PDG du groupe Valmont, Adrien, pendant dix ans. Pour aider son groupe, elle commence à travailler dans son hôtel.
Une rencontre inattendue débouche sur un mariage aussi surprenant que rapide
Mais ce mariage n'est pas un hasard.
Adrien l'aimait aussi en secret depuis toutes ces années.
Après dix ans d'amour en secret, ils s'avouent enfin leurs sentiments, mettant fin à leur longue attente.

video:video.video:title: Everything's on My Side: Daddy, I'm Coming
video:video.video:description: During a conflict with the Quinn fake heiress, young Ellie Quinn gets hurt while protecting her ill mother, unexpectedly awakening her ability to hear the voices of everything in the world. As impostors take their places in the reunion with her wealthy father, Ellie speaks to the world—animals, vases, and even desks—guiding her mother toward their true home.

video:video.video:title: The Mermaid's Tear
video:video.video:description: Saved as a child by fisherman Henry, mermaid Freya repays him by marrying his grandson Anderson for three years, secretly aiding him with magic. He scorns her and believes his ex Chloe's lies. At Contract Expiry, she signs the divorce. Henry's flash drive reveals the truth, and Anderson begs her back. At the Admiralty Circle induction ceremony, Freya is revealed as the Sea Goddess. Exposed, Chloe strikes with a dagger and Anderson takes the blow. Freya heals him, but will she love him again?

video:video.video:title: Guardian to Groom
video:video.video:description: Secretly in love with her guardian and Alpha King, Calvin, Nora confesses on her 22st birthday, only to be cold-heartedly rejected. Heartbroken, she joins a lethal mission and takes a fatal hit. Facing her near-death, Calvin finally breaks his restraint—disowning her as guardian to claim her as his soulmate.

video:video.video:title: Agent of Shadows
video:video.video:description: The world's greatest secret agent must protect and care for his six-year-old daughter while posing as her nanny. Now, without revealing his true identity, he must win his daughter's (and her mother's) trust, while secretly thwarting corrupt suitors, mafioso strongmen, and even a megalomaniacal billionaire who's using his family to get to him.

video:video.video:title: After the Alpha's Cruel Trials
video:video.video:description: Violet gave seventeen of her life to her fated mate — Kaden Cross. She grew up by his side, devoting everything to him. But when the whole pack turns on her for being a "wolfless burden," Kaden is the one leading their attack, bullying Violet with her stepsister. Humiliated, devastated, betrayed, Violet opens her eyes and makes a choice. She breaks their mate bond and leave this monstrous place behind. The heir to the strongest pack in the realm, Sebastian, arrives to pick her up. His quiet, never-wavering trust is the one to coax her sleeping wolf awake. But right as Violet's about to break free and start again— the man that cast her out is the one on his knees, begging for her to come back.

video:video.video:title: Mistaken for My Brother-in-law's Sex Doll
video:video.video:description: Lucy, a pawn in an arranged marriage, is betrayed by her husband and stepsister. One night, mafia boss Ethan mistakes her for a sex doll. Under his cold domination, she awakens. She decides to become his perfect toy and use him to destroy everyone who betrayed her.

video:video.video:title: Bonded to Love: My Pretend Boyfriend
video:video.video:description: Olivia signed a contract with the wealthy Edward to pretend to be his girlfriend. But unexpectedly, they fell in love for real. However, just as Olivia discovered she was pregnant with Edward's child, she was forced to get involved in a bloody power struggle within the wealthy family.

video:video.video:title: A Breath Away From Forever
video:video.video:description: Five years ago, Callista Summers rescued Jeremiah Fuller when he was drugged. She then pursued her career abroad, driven by her initial self-doubt as a housekeeper. Over time, Callista became a renowned designer and a devoted mother to her son, Scotty Fuller. When she learns of Jeremiah’s kidney failure, she selflessly returns to donate her kidney, saving him once more. However, misunderstandings breed animosity between them.

video:video.video:title: CEO's Apology: Rebuilding Love After Divorce
video:video.video:description: Su Qi became Li Jingchen's wife, but did not gain his respect. When she was kicked out of the house that rainy night, she was determined to divorce him. Later, Li Jingchen realized that it is so easy to break love, but so difficult to rebuild it.

video:video.video:title: En Fuite avec le Bébé du Patron
video:video.video:description: Héloïse Garnier, génie de l'informatique et héritière de la plus grande fortune du Sud, tombe sous le charme de Clovis Tessier, PDG des LM, après qu'il l'a sauvée lors d'un gala il y a trois ans. En quête d'un amour sincère, elle cache son identité et devient sa secrétaire de direction, vivant une histoire d'amour secrète pendant trois ans.

video:video.video:title: Poseidon
video:video.video:description: Seven years ago, a mortal girl named Chloe saved the heavily injured Sea God, Poseidon. Grateful, Poseidon promised to return in seven years and marry her. Seven years later, Poseidon disguises himself as a wealthy mortal noble named "Payson" to pursue Chloe, who now works as a handmaiden in his temple. However, terrified of divine punishment for the forbidden love between gods and mortals, Chloe repeatedly rejects his advances. Their romance faces immense obstacles. They must navigate the jealousy and schemes of Dora, a mortal noblewoman. Furthermore, Poseidon's mother, Rhea, fiercely intervenes, and his divine fiancée, Amphitrite, goes so far as to cruelly torture and disfigure Chloe. To protect Chloe, Poseidon is willing to renounce his godhood, endure heavenly lightning strikes, and make enemies of the gods. In a desperate bid to save Poseidon's life, Chloe agrees to marry Kael, a mortal nouveau riche. However, when Kael drugs and attempts to assault her on their wedding day, Poseidon arrives just in time to rescue her, leading to their passionate reconciliation and union. In the climax, Poseidon uses his formidable divine power to defeat Zeus, who tries to use the situation to execute him. Upon discovering that Chloe is pregnant with Poseidon's divine child, Rhea finally accepts that their union is destined. Forced to concede, Zeus abolishes the ancient law forbidding love between gods and mortals. The story concludes with a grand beach wedding for Poseidon and Chloe, bringing the tale to a happy ending.

video:video.video:title: Roaming the World Untamed
video:video.video:description: Roaming the World Untamed

video:video.video:title: Forbidden Night The Billionaire Wolf and His Private Doctor
video:video.video:description: Forbidden Night The Billionaire Wolf and His Private Doctor

video:video.video:title: The Shadow King's Pet
video:video.video:description: The Shadow King's Pet

video:video.video:title: Married the Mafia Don, Now My Ex Regrets Everything
video:video.video:description: Ivy endured years as a quiet, devoted wife, only to be brutally betrayed and thrown into a blizzard by her arrogant ex. With nowhere else to go, she flash-marries Aiden, the dangerous stranger she saved years ago. Passion ignites as Aiden ruthlessly shields her from her toxic ex and empowers her to finally stand on her own. When her ex regrets his mistake and comes crawling back, Ivy has already moved on—and her new husband? A lethal predator her ex can never even dream of touching...

video:video.video:title: The Bride They Gave the Beast
video:video.video:description: Betrayed by her fiancé Anton for her sister Agathe, Beauty secretly marries the terrifying Beast in Agathe's place to save her village. Instead of a monster, Beauty finds a compassionate protector and falls in love. When Anton uncovers the switch, he jealously kidnaps a pregnant Beauty, but the Beast rescues her. Choosing mercy over revenge, Beauty spares Anton. Ultimately, their true love breaks the ancient curse, transforming the Beast back into a prince.

video:video.video:title: Lear, M.D., Lady of Hearts
video:video.video:description: She was killed by her stepmother while possessing a secret book, but she was reborn as an unpopular young lady in ancient times. As soon as she opened her eyes, she was forced to save a handsome boy. Fortunately, the handsome boy asked for a decree granting marriage, but who knew that he was actually Greedy for my body? !

video:video.video:title: Tuned to Your Heart
video:video.video:description: At five years old, Luna York and William Grant are orphaned and eventually lose contact with each other. Years later, Luna mistakes Wilson Lowe for William and sacrifices her future for him at eighteen—only to face humiliation and mistreatment. Framed for plagiarism, she is rescued by the real William, who recognizes her but hesitates to reunite—until the truth finally comes to light.

video:video.video:title: My Heart Has Always Known
video:video.video:description: To save her mom from an abusive relationship with her father, Nina Judd agrees to take the place of her sister, who has vanished, in a marriage alliance with the heir of the powerful Zanes, Sean. Despite supposedly marrying into a life of luxury, she realizes her new husband is a workaholic who has little interest in her. Little does she know, her caring nature melts Sean's cold heart, and what appeared to be a marriage of benefit turns out to be the true love.

video:video.video:title: Sleeping Beside Danger
video:video.video:description: On Jane Shaw's birthday, she barely survives a car accident. But the moment she wakes up, she witnesses a horrifying scene as her husband, Sean Cole, and their maid, Tina Holt, are plotting her death. In an instant, every dream and hope she once had for a happy life in a loving home shatters. The man she loves most has become her greatest enemy, and Jane finds herself trapped like a pawn on a chessboard, waiting to be sacrificed.

video:video.video:title: What Broke Wasn't Just the Vow
video:video.video:description: Alicia Blair spends years trying to be the perfect wife to Jasper Kane—only to discover their "perfect" marriage is nothing but a lie. Just as she gathers the strength to leave and files for divorce, Jasper realizes too late that he's truly fallen for her.

video:video.video:title: Craving My Brother's Best Friend
video:video.video:description: After accidentally emailing a steamy fanfiction to her new roommate—who happens to be her brother's best friend—Alison must navigate rising sexual tension and her brother's strict "Bro Code" to get the guy of her dreams.

video:video.video:title: My Mafia Life: From Maid to Bride
video:video.video:description: Rosa is the maid of the mafia boss Max, suffering constant bullying and longing to break free from his control. When the chance to escape finally comes, it is ruthlessly cut off by Max himself, whose possessiveness toward Rosa grows even stronger. Their twisted love seems to be connected to Rosa's mysterious past, and when the truth is revealed, former lovers turn into mortal enemies. How will they face their fate?

video:video.video:title: My Dark Romeo
video:video.video:description: After Romeo Costa ruins Dallas Townsend's reputation at the debutante ball and forces her into a marriage, Dallas makes a new plan: seduce him, break his rule, and get the family she’s always dreamed of. But Romeo is not easy to break. And Dallas isn't the type of girl to give up.

video:video.video:title: The Day My Stepbrother Knows My Dirty Secret
video:video.video:description: I accidentally give my crush’s rival a love letter—then realize it’s actually the porn I wrote. Worse, he turns out to be my new stepbrother- a total devil! Now we’re stuck living under the same roof, he’s holding my embarrassing secret over me… and somehow, we start falling for each other...

video:video.video:title: Destiny's Keeper
video:video.video:description: He was clearly the strongest man in the world, yet he was mistaken for a beggar.

video:video.video:title: The Eyes That See Beyond
video:video.video:description: When campus beauty Yara Gray accidentally knocks Sean Carter flying, the poor student’s life changes overnight—he suddenly awakens X-ray vision. His shocking abilities stun everyone around him. Mob heiress Vicky Lowe, Skye Hall, Annie Snow, and even Yara Gray herself are left speechless. Well, who wouldn’t want someone like him?

video:video.video:title: Slept With My Alpha Mate
video:video.video:description: She is forced to marry her sick husband, not realizing that he is the most powerful Alpha. Alicia gets drugged and sleeps with Damian who she feels may be her mate, but she tells Damian that she’s married. Despite that Alicia never actually met her husband Tobias, she chooses to stay loyal to her marriage, as her father still needs the financial aids from the Wilton family. Alicia then discovers Damian’s identity as the alpha of the Moon Halo pack, when she’s asked to be the landscape designer of his new villa. As Alicia finds herself starting to catch feelings for Dammian, she gets the news from Martin that her husband Tobias is awake, but Tobias refuses her request to meet.

video:video.video:title: Corrupting My Billionaire Boss's Heart
video:video.video:description: When Lyla Walker starts working at the world's most elite country club, she unwittingly brings chaos and temptation to her buttoned-up billionaire CEO Royce Kennedy. She's ready to risk everything for their forbidden relationship, unaware of the promise he made to her dying father.

video:video.video:title: The Day the Champion Racer Lost His Bride
video:video.video:description: For five years, Alexis poured her entire heart into Ryder Kane—the golden boy of the racing world. She thought they were building a future together. But on the day she planned to propose, she learned the truth: Ryder never saw her as a partner. Just a placeholder. A “practice girlfriend.” Shattered, Alexis accepts an unexpected proposal from billionaire Everett Hale—and cuts Ryder out of her life for good. Now Ryder is forced to face the fallout. Will he let her walk away… or will losing her push him into a spiral of obsession, regret, and the fight of his life?

video:video.video:title: Rules Were Never Her Thing (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: After ten years of suffering with the Lowe family, May Lowe finally glimpses hope when she meets Max Dow. Initially, she sees him only as a means to escape her family's virtual prison, but as time passes, she finds herself falling for him. His unwavering trust and devotion slowly break down her walls. Though their bond begins with deception, it ultimately leads them toward salvation and healing, their souls bound together on the path to recovery.

video:video.video:title: Bound by Love
video:video.video:description: Aria won Luca’s love in an arranged mafia marriage, but when she secretly helps her sister flee the life, she betrays him. With their families at war and a baby on the way, Aria must decide whether love can survive when loyalty is paid for in blood.

video:video.video:title: Spoiling My Sweet Wife to Her Core（DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: On the day of the engagement, Anne Miller was framed in a cheating scandal. Her fiance, Shawn Smith, was furious and vowed never to marry Anne. She knew that her pretentious step-sister, Elsa Miller, was the mastermind behind it all. Shawn believed entirely in Elsa's lies. Devastated, Anne died with resentment and regret.A soul of a heroine—who shared the same name as Anne—transmigrated into Anne Miller's body and swore to avenge her.

video:video.video:title: I'm pregnant, it's not yours
video:video.video:description: Husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.

video:video.video:title: My Boss Loves Me Too Much
video:video.video:description: Ella planned to challenge herself by taking a new job after years of managing crises, but her world is turned upside down when her new boss, Christian, drags her in a fake marriage! What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes something far more intense. Every touch, every kiss, draws Ella deeper into his world. But what she doesn’t know is that Christian has been playing a dangerous game all along, determined to make her his forever.

video:video.video:title: XL Stands for Xtra Love
video:video.video:description: Ellie wants to be a world famous model, but no one'll give a chubby girl a chance. She has a one-night stand with fashion company CEO Eason, raising their son Lucas alone. Hoping to land a job as a model, she answers HALE Group's casting call only to discover that the boss interviewing is her baby daddy, Eason Hale himself!

video:video.video:title: Daddy, Mom Is Not Crazy
video:video.video:description: Brianna, an ordinary young woman, underwent an agonizing bone marrow transplant while pregnant to save her boyfriend Alexander Clark, the richest man.
