Cinda, Alexander’s childhood sweetheart, bribed the doctors in a bid to kill her. Believing Brianna had passed away, Alexander was utterly heartbroken and remained unmarried for years. Cinda survived but lost her sanity, wandering the streets with her son and begging for a living. Years later, Clark chanced upon the ragged, mentally disturbed mother and her child. He snapped at them, mistaking them for scammers. It was not until he got a clear look at the woman’s face that he realized she was the lover he had missed deeply all these years.

video:video.video:title: Don’t Deport My Luna
video:video.video:description: Emma Young, the Canadian designer, is stuck with an expiring visa, so what does she do? She goes and marries this guy she bumps into, Alexander Kingsley. Little did she know, he's not just some big shot running KS Fashion, but also the top dog of the Crimson Shadow pack. At first, Emma thought this marriage was just a quick fix, but Alexander's smooth moves got her hooked. Their whole 'pretend' marriage turns into this crazy love story, like marrying the wrong car but finding the right guy.

video:video.video:title: When Forever Fell Apart
video:video.video:description: For their sixth anniversary, Natalie wants to surprise her husband Ethan, so she goes to the clinic to check on the sperm he stored… only to find out he took it out long ago! Turns out, he donated to his ex and childhood crush so she could have his baby! And now that woman is back—with the child. Worse, Ethan actually brings them into their home, as if they belonged there. After being let down again and again, Natalie finally makes up her mind. She’s done. She wants a divorce. She’s walking away. For good. Will Ethan manage to save their marriage before it's lost forever, or will Natalie disappear before Ethan realizes that he's lost a truly good woman?

video:video.video:title: [ENG DUB] The Abandoned Bride Married a Tycoon
video:video.video:description: Rumor said Yedda Victor, a daughter of the Victor family, who grew up in the countryside and was known for her ridiculous antics, had deeply fallen in love with a wealthy businessman, Ethan Seth. However, on the day of their wedding, Ethan ran away. Angered by his actions, Yedda also fled the scene and met the world's most mysterious genius, Roy Grant. He planned a deliberate car accident and offered to marry Yedda as compensation, and she readily agreed. Thus, they married by contract. After their marriage, Roy concealed his real status. Not only did he elevate his young wife to new heights, but he also helped her find respect in the Victor family.

video:video.video:title: Moving On From You (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Jane Rowe has been in love with Sam Bale ever since he took her in at the age of seven. Every year on her birthday, she confesses her feelings, only to be rejected as Sam, believing their ten-year age gap is too large, chooses someone else.One night, they get drunk and spend the night together, but Sam has no recollection of it. When Jane becomes pregnant, Sam accuses her of being indecent. Heartbroken, Jane leaves him to continue his life with his girlfriend.

video:video.video:title: Too Wet For Yoga
video:video.video:description: Chloe's controlling husband hires his friend Jack as her hot yoga instructor, unaware he's her former lover. With her husband watching through the glass, every touch rekindles a forbidden desire. Guilt tells her to stop. Her body begs for more. But beneath the heat lies a ruthless scheme that could leave her with nothing. Is Jack her second chance at love, or the trap that will cost her everything?

video:video.video:title: My Scar, His Debt to Pay
video:video.video:description: Rachel and Ethan were trapped in a war zone. While trying to save Ethan, Rachel was left with a disfiguring scar on her face. They fell in love and got married, but there was only one evacuation spot. Rachel gave it to the injured Ethan, and Ethan promised he would come back for her—unaware that Rachel later discovered she was pregnant. Six years later, Rachel returns to the country to save her daughter, Sophie, only to find that Ethan had already married the hospital director’s daughter and started a new family after his return. To protect his reputation and status, Ethan even slandered Rachel and Sophie. At this critical moment, Rachel’s long-lost father finds her and reveals that she is actually the daughter of the chairman of the Harrington Medical Group. In the end, the scumbag doctor loses everything and suffers the consequences of his own actions, while Rachel goes on to live a happy life with her daughter.

video:video.video:title: A Battle for Blood and Honor
video:video.video:description: After winning the championship of the Labustia Tournament, Timothy Yates loses his family to Shawn Larson, who murders his wife and takes his son. Honoring his late wife's wish, Timothy lets go of all grudges and lives an ordinary life as a cleaner, only to be forced to return to the battlefield twenty years later when John Weston, a warrior nurtured by Shawn, challenges Labustia Hall.

video:video.video:title: Two Hearts Aligned Under the Moon
video:video.video:description: Lin Qingdai, who traveled to the world of the book and became a cannon fodder female supporting actress, used her supernatural space to save Nangong Heiyuan on his wedding night and prepare supplies to deal with the upcoming exile of her family. On the way to exile, she overcomes the difficulties, and works with her crippled husband and family to tide over the difficulties, and eventually reaps the benefits of happiness.

video:video.video:title: Ties That Bind (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Myla Abner, whose real name is Bella Stone, is the daughter of a wealthy family in Valia known as the Stones. She was abandoned in a fire during a family trip in the mountains when they chose to save her brother instead of her. Surviving against the odds, Myla is later taken in by Sarah Abner, who raises her under the assumption that she has lost her memory. Fourteen years later, Myla goes to work and coincidentally has her long-lost brother, Ben Stone, as her superior.

video:video.video:title: (Doublage)DEUX ALPHAS DESTINÉS POUR MOI
video:video.video:description: Je ne suis pas une Omega, mais la Reine Louve Blanche. Damien (Alpha de Moonhowl) : Tu aimais regarder mes abdos, non ? Tout de moi sera à toi — gratuit. Ronan (Alpha de Nightfang) : Petite louve, embrasse-moi, ma vie est à toi ! James (un autre Alpha) : Je ferai en sorte que tu ne sortes pas du lit pendant dix jours d'affilée…

video:video.video:title: A Hidden Sword Emperor
video:video.video:description: A popular Kpop composer, who broke up with his girlfriend, learns she died in Vietnam. Having a hard time composing new music, he hears a piano piece and feels compelled to travel to Vietnam to find its origin.

video:video.video:title: Hear Me Once More
video:video.video:description: An abusive parent makes young Dorothy and Nelson the closest of allies - but a car accident tears them apart. When their paths cross once again in adulthood, will they recognize each other and let their bond bloom once more?

video:video.video:title: Private School Playboys
video:video.video:description: Head over heels for Ethan Sutton, it-boy of Lowell Private Academy, Maddie Sinclair has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with heiress Vanessa Archibald, Madeline hatches a grand escape plan with Ethan's opportunistic mother. Will Ethan capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Rhys Wyndham, mysterious new bad boy from London end up sealing the deal before Maddie even boards the plane?

video:video.video:title: High Society
video:video.video:description: Adele was born with nothing: no last name, no family, no home. But then she meets Cesare Buonaparte. The Duke. The most feared man on their island nation. And finally, she has a chance to become something more. To bring herself out of poverty and save her friend's life, she makes a deal with the Duke: she'll help him escape an arranged marriage by pretending to be his long-lost sister. Though he's the most gorgeous, infuriating man she's ever met, siblings—even fake ones—can never fall in love. So... why does he keep looking at her like that?

video:video.video:title: Wake Up, My Billionaire Husband
video:video.video:description: Sofía is short on money and desperate to pay her mother's expensive medical bills. Her relatives agree to help her on the condition that she marries the billionaire Samuel, who is in a coma after a near-fatal car accident. However, it won't be long before the infamous Samuel wakes up from his coma and discovers he's engaged to a complete stranger.

video:video.video:title: Divorce, My Happily Ever After (DUBBED)
video:video.video:description: Betrayed by her husband and his mistress while five months pregnant, Rosie Turner is cast out in humiliation despite having sacrificed everything for him. After the divorce, she finds new strength in Andrew Jaffe, a young and charismatic CEO who not only helps her seek revenge but also supports her rise to success. With him by her side, Rosie discovers both triumph in her career and lasting happiness in love.

video:video.video:title: You Are My Sunshine
video:video.video:description: Marrying Yun Chen has been Su Jinyan's wish since childhood. After the marriage, layers of misunderstandings caused him to torture her to the bone, and she could not let go of it until her death.

video:video.video:title: My Handsome Bodyguard [English]
video:video.video:description: Chu Tao, a former Dragon General turned single father and security guard, navigates secrets of the past while entering a contractual marriage with Lin Wan'er, an ambitious leader seeking vengeance.

video:video.video:title: In His Obsession, She Belongs
video:video.video:description: Fiona Joel has been engaged to her fiancé for four years. During that time, he has slept with dozens of women. Although Fiona pretends to be hurt by his infidelities, she secretly feels relieved, knowing she will marry into a wealthy family without having to fulfill the role of a devoted spouse to a man she doesn't even like. To even the score, she spends a night of passion with a stranger while waiting for the elevator, and the mysterious man accepts.

video:video.video:title: The Love She Lost to the World
video:video.video:description: Claudia Zabel is the daughter of the Judd family’s maid. She fell for Hector Judd the moment she laid eyes on him. However, Hector’s heart had long been claimed by his childhood sweetheart, Natalie Yowell. At seventeen, he was even blinded in a car accident while trying to save her. Natalie eventually left Hector for another man. Meanwhile, Claudia stayed by his side and devotedly cared for him for seven years.

video:video.video:title: Billionaire on Plane
video:video.video:description: drama

video:video.video:title: The Fallen Heiress's Return
video:video.video:description: Once mocked as a “poor girlfriend,” she stuns everyone at the party—revealed as both a lost heiress and the boss of a deadly syndicate.

video:video.video:title: [Doublé]À son tour de tomber
video:video.video:description: Marc Moreau a aidé la reine du campus, Jeanne Martin, à devenir une véritable reine des affaires. Mais au final, Jeanne l'a poussé du toit à la mort, convaincue qu'elle aurait pu être avec le beau gosse du campus, Julien Dupont, et que Marc ne l'avait liée à lui que par l'argent. Renaissant avec une seconde chance, Marc décide d'abandonner Jeanne et de reprendre sa vie en main. De son côté, Jeanne renaît elle aussi : persuadée que son succès venait uniquement d'elle-même, elle pense pouvoir réussir à nouveau et vivre un bel avenir avec Julien. Mais après le redémarrage de leur vie, Marc ne tourne plus autour d'elle. Pire encore, il se rapproche de Sophie Laurent, héritière de la famille Laurent. Et Julien est loin d'être l'homme idéal qu'elle imaginait...

video:video.video:title: The Secret He Keeps, the Love I Feel
video:video.video:description: When Iris Turner’s parents die and the family’s company goes bankrupt, her brother, Daniel Turner, abandons her at the home of his archrival, Lucius Craig. To survive, she throws herself into playing the part of a damsel in distress. But little does she know—she has been the true prey all along.

video:video.video:title: The Mafia King Kept Me in the Dark
video:video.video:description: 24-year-old college student Isabelle, trying to escape the control of her brother Gavin, accidentally saves Myron, the grandfather of Nathan, the leader of the mafia, only to lose her sight in the process. To repay her kindness, Myron arranges a sudden marriage between Isabelle and Nathan. Suspecting that Isabelle is colluding with her brother, Nathan conceals his true identity and pretends to be poor to test her.

video:video.video:title: I Accidentally Claimed Four Royals With A Kiss
video:video.video:description: Modern girl Sylvia is transported to a magical world as a powerless nobody. Desperate, she binds a "Love Contract System"—only by kissing powerful mages can she survive and share their power. She kisses icy genius Adrian, awakens immense magic, then bonds with elves, dragons, and shadow lords. But the contract hides a secret that could unleash an ancient evil. With dark forces closing in, can Sylvia balance the backlash and her true heart?

video:video.video:title: Marry The Wrong Bride
video:video.video:description: Bianca Anderson has been contracted by her father to marry Angelo de Rossi, the heir to the Rossi multimillion company since she was just a child. But growing up to be an independent woman, she finds it off to marry a man she has never seen before. She tricks her twin sister, CAMILLA Anderson, into taking her place a few days before the wedding. On the wedding day, Bianca is shocked to see a very handsome man at the end of the aisle.

video:video.video:title: Surrendering to Your Heart
video:video.video:description: Sue Leed, a bright and independent village girl, endures constant oppression from her family. Not only do they refuse to support her education, but they also attempt to force her into an unwanted marriage. Determined to reclaim her future, Sue escapes and, in a twist of fate, finds herself in the luxurious car of Hans Good, a wealthy CEO. Although Hans is typically indifferent to romance, he is instantly captivated by Sue.

video:video.video:title: When The Mafia Boss Has Your Back
video:video.video:description: Luke Moore, a business prodigy, made a name for himself when he was 18 years old and returned to his country, founding Moor Corp at the age of 21. However, after being betrayed by his family, he conceals his identity and works as a food delivery rider. When he learns that his girlfriend has cheated on him, he finds himself being pursued. Fortunately, Lena King, someone he met during his childhood, rescues him. Because of the promise they made when they were young, she pressures him to marry her. With Lena's protection and companionship, Luke gradually leaves the past behind and embraces the future with her.

video:video.video:title: Defying Doom: The Clash of Fate
video:video.video:description: In exchange for his divine powers as the Mystic Lord, Jason Long is destined for a short life. To change his fate, he embarks on a quest for the legendary Volatile. As events unfold, he becomes the live-in “unwanted” boyfriend of Rina Shaw, the heir to the prestigious Shaw family. Determined to protect her from his vengeful ex-girlfriend and a mysterious masked figure, Jason faces a series of challenges.

video:video.video:title: A Dance Between Chains and Freedom
video:video.video:description: In her past life, Sarah Garner was sent as a hostage and tortured to death. Reborn outside King Cyrus' camp, she chooses a new path—captivating Cyrus with her dance instead of becoming a miserable prostitute. Though kept under threat, Sarah pretends to obey while secretly plotting revenge. She manipulates the man who once abused her and spreads rumors about Cyrus, all while staying close enough to slowly win his heart.

video:video.video:title: Plan B Bride: She Who Turned the Tables
video:video.video:description: Madge Pearce, a transmigrated daughter, marries into the infamous Marquis Manor in place of her reborn sister. By the time her long-missing husband—rumored to be a womanizer—returns years later, she has already built a fortune of her own. Yet the moment they meet, something about him feels strangely different.

video:video.video:title: Out of the Abyss: Ready to Strike
video:video.video:description: Falling into her stepsister Kathy Ford’s trap, Cindy Ford is severely injured and loses the Mystery Box that her biological mother left for her on the night before marrying Miguel Wood. Fortunately, she is saved by the Divine Healer, Ken Shaw. She returns after three years with the medical techniques she learned from Ken and the vast wealth of the Astral Alliance to ruin Kathy and Miguel’s wedding.

video:video.video:title: Beyond Medicine: The Healer in Rags
video:video.video:description: Andy Quinn is a legend—the founder of Overlord Corp and the revered "Sage of Medicine." Yet, he roams the streets as a beggar, helping those in need. In Xanor, billionaire Max Gray offers a fortune to anyone who can cure his ailing daughter, Tina, but no doctor succeeds. One day, his second daughter, Sophie, donates to Andy, who offers to grant her a wish. She brings him home, and to everyone’s shock, he cures Tina with ease.
